articles.title: Aave restores ether borrowing limits after $230 million exploit
articles.snippet: The DeFi lending protocol reversed restrictions imposed after April’s $292 million exploit, restoring borrowing capacity across six networks as contagion fears ease.

articles.title: XRP price may explode to $15 amid 'quiet accumulation,' analyst claims
articles.snippet: XRP still faces short-term downside risk, with a symmetrical triangle breakdown pointing to a possible drop toward $1.00–$1.10.

articles.title: Verus Ethereum bridge reportedly exploited for $11.6M in latest DeFi attack
articles.snippet: Two security companies have flagged the address where the stolen funds are allegedly being held, showing the cryptocurrencies have been converted into 5,402 Ether.

articles.title: WETH markets return to normal operations on Aave amid rsETH recovery progress
articles.snippet: Aave applied a temporary freeze to WETH as a precautionary safety measure in response to the Kelp DAO exploit, alongside freezes on the rsETH and wrsETH reserves.

articles.title: Lombard Finance Dumps LayerZero, Will Use Chainlink to Power $1 Billion in Bitcoin Assets
articles.snippet: The Bitcoin DeFi protocol is moving its assets away from LayerZero following the Kelp DAO exploit that led to the loss of $292 million.
